name: cvim-desktop
description: Tamer (CVIM v2) desktop app — Electron + Rust core (cvim-core)

scripts.electron:pack: npm run core:build && chmod +x node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/*/spawn-helper && python3 build/make_icon.py >/dev/null && node scripts/notices.cjs && node scripts/stamp.cjs dev && vite build && electron-packager . Tamer --out=out --overwrite --icon=build/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=dev.tamer.desktop --ignore="^/src$" --ignore="^/out" --ignore="^/core-rs" --ignore="^/scripts" --ignore="^/test" --ignore="^/build" --extra-resource=core-rs/target/release/cvim-core --extra-resource=../claude --extra-resource=../agents --extra-resource=build/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt --extra-resource=node_modules/electron/dist/LICENSES.chromium.html --extend-info=electron/Info.extra.plist --asar.unpack="**/node_modules/node-pty/**" && node scripts/prune-locales.cjs out/Tamer-darwin-arm64/Tamer.app && node scripts/fuses.cjs && node scripts/sign.cjs out/Tamer-darwin-arm64/Tamer.app
